title: test(e2e): lookup quick-filter coverage (CRM parity)
body:
Adds the record-picker dropdown case to the ADR-0047 live e2e suite: the Task List view's `project` lookup filter opens a searchable record list; picking a record narrows the grid, persists as `uf_project`, and the badge shows the selection. This is the path hotcrm's account workbench ([hotcrm#383](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/pull/383), `owner` user lookup) depends on.

Skips gracefully when the running showcase predates the lookup example (framework companion: showcase `project` quick filter).

5/5 live specs pass against the local stack.
